_what: Collier's editing preferences, 2026-08-26. Applies to BOTH brands unless noted.

source_material._implication: Sprawling, long, and repetitive by nature — the same point often gets made in two or three places. This is exactly the material `multi_topic_merge` (structure lift 2.99, the highest available) is for. Actively weld the best statements of one idea into a single arc; do NOT default to front_trim.

cut_tightness._note: KIT DEFAULT — Collier chose to keep it (2026-08-26) after being offered 0.35.
cut_tightness._word_safety: Words are safe at any setting: jumpcut.py removes time from the MIDDLE of a confirmed silence and keeps max_pause/2 of real silence on each side, so the previous word's tail and the next word's onset are never touched.
cut_tightness._if_too_snappy: If a real clip flattens a grammatical beat or a pause before a punchline, raise --max-pause toward 0.30. Judge it on actual footage, not in the abstract.

captions.size: kit default (150px at 4K / 75px at 1080) — Collier: 'base captions are good to start'
captions.position: kit default y=50% of frame height (above the platform UI)
captions.manual_placement: REQUESTED — Collier wants to drag caption position before the burn. See tools/caption_place.py.
captions._note: Do not change size or position defaults without asking; he explicitly approved the base.

clip_length._note: No target duration. Length is whatever the complete arc needs — hook, build, payoff. Never pad to hit a number, never truncate a landing to stay short.

never_publish: Collier's own salary from Facility Coach ($100k) and FC's net margin — kept off at his direction 2026-09-09
FC's own ad performance figures (ROAS, spend) — treat as internal
Any client's or member's name, revenue, or price points — their business, not FC's to post
Collier's personal cell number — spoken aloud in several recordings
banned._note: Standing selector bans still apply: no opening on a literal question (0.18), no ending before the explanation (0.35), no motivational framing without a mechanism.

clip_gating.rule: Collier's FACE and Collier's VOICE, both. A moment where he is speaking but Zoom shows someone else does NOT qualify.
clip_gating.method: SFace recognition against collier_ref.npy. Threshold 0.363. Verify the RENDERED clip frame-by-frame with tools/verify — sampled scans of the source miss switches.
clip_gating._why: On 2026-09-09 an 8s-sampled scan passed two clips that contained the prospect; frame-level verification of the render caught both.

zoom_source_note: Active-speaker recordings cut away every 3-10s and often land on the prospect mid-payoff. Ask Collier to enable Zoom's 'Record a separate audio/video file for each participant' — he agreed to this 2026-09-09.
